texas-a-m-university.about:
Texas A&M is a flagship land-grant, sea-grant and space-grant university with more than 70,000 students and a famously strong campus culture (the Aggie traditions and Corps of Cadets). It has one of the largest engineering colleges in the US, top programmes in agriculture, veterinary medicine and petroleum engineering, and branch campuses in Galveston, McAllen and Qatar.

International freshmen apply through ApplyTexas or the Common App with transcripts, essays and proof of English (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 or SAT/ACT English sections). Testing is optional, and the main Fall deadline is 1 December. Aid for internationals is limited to some merit scholarships.
texas-a-m-university.aid_intl: Limited merit scholarships for international students; no need-based federal aid.
texas-a-m-university.tests: Test optional: SAT/ACT not required for freshman applicants (scores may be sent). English proficiency: TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 with 4.0 per skill on the new scale; IELTS Academic 6.0; TOEFL Essentials 8.5; or SAT EBRW 560 / ACT English 21. MyBest scores not accepted.
texas-a-m-university.gpa_note: Holistic review of academic record and essays; Texas top-6% students are auto-admitted, international applicants compete for remaining places.
requirements: Required essay (e.g. a life event that prepared you for college)
English proficiency (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / SAT EBRW 560 / ACT English 21)
Financial documentation for the I-20/F-1 visa

tianjin-university.about:
Tianjin University, founded in 1895 as Peiyang University, is a leading engineering-focused research university. It is best known for chemical engineering, architecture, precision instruments and optoelectronics, and civil and hydraulic engineering, and runs a joint campus with Fuzhou.

International applicants apply online with school records, HSK (or English scores for English-taught options) and a CSCA report, and may be interviewed. CSC and Tianjin scholarships are offered.
tianjin-university.aid_intl: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.
tianjin-university.tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.
tianjin-university.gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.
requirements: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

tongji-university.about:
Tongji University was founded in 1907 by German physicians and keeps strong German links (including the Chinese-German College). It is one of the world's top schools for architecture and urban planning and for civil and transportation engineering, with additional strength in automotive engineering, environmental science and design.

International applicants apply online with school records, HSK (or English scores for the few English-taught options) and a CSCA report. CSC and Shanghai Government scholarships help with costs.
tongji-university.aid_intl: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.
tongji-university.tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.
tongji-university.gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.
requirements: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

university-of-antwerp.about:
The University of Antwerp was formed in 2003 from three Antwerp institutions and has campuses in the city centre and the south of Antwerp. It is known for business and economics, pharmaceutical and biomedical sciences, medicine, law, applied engineering and port/logistics research, and is closely linked to the Antwerp Management School.

Almost all bachelor's programmes are Dutch-taught; the main English-taught option is Social-Economic Sciences. International applicants apply online from 4 November, uploading documents by 28 February (final deadline 31 May), and medicine requires the Flemish entrance exam.
university-of-antwerp.aid_intl: Limited; UAntwerp scholarships mainly target master's students from developing countries.
university-of-antwerp.tests: No SAT/ACT. Most bachelor's programmes are taught in Dutch (B2 Dutch needed); the Bachelor of Social-Economic Sciences is taught in English and requires proof of English. Medicine and dentistry require the Flemish entrance exam.
university-of-antwerp.gpa_note: Open admission with a recognised secondary diploma plus language proof; medicine is selective via entrance exam.
requirements: Secondary school diploma (legalised/certified copy to the registrar)
Dutch B2 for Dutch-taught programmes; English proficiency for English-taught programmes
Proof of funds for the Belgian student visa

university-of-canterbury-te-whare-wanang.about:
Founded in 1873, the University of Canterbury has a large, leafy campus in Christchurch. It is especially strong in engineering (civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical and natural resources), geology and natural hazards, forestry, Antarctic studies, computer science and education, and is known for a lively student culture.

International students apply through myUC with their school results and English evidence, starting in February or July. Merit scholarships for international first-year students are available, and Christchurch offers a lower cost of living than Auckland.
university-of-canterbury-te-whare-wanang.aid_intl: International merit scholarships such as the UC International First-Year Scholarship (partial tuition).
university-of-canterbury-te-whare-wanang.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/other) required for non-native speakers at the level set for each degree.
university-of-canterbury-te-whare-wanang.gpa_note: Entry equivalent to NZ University Entrance; engineering requires strong maths and physics.
requirements: English test (programme level; IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5 is typical)
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

university-of-gothenburg.about:
The University of Gothenburg is one of Scandinavia's largest universities, with faculties spread across central Gothenburg covering arts, education, fine and performing arts, IT, natural sciences, health (Sahlgrenska Academy), social sciences and the School of Business, Economics and Law.

Most bachelor's programmes are Swedish-taught, with a small set in English. International applicants apply through universityadmissions.se by 15 January, submitting transcripts and proof of English 6; non-EU/EEA citizens pay an application fee and tuition.
university-of-gothenburg.aid_intl: Few or no bachelor's-level scholarships; Swedish Institute scholarships are for master's students. Some universities offer partial tuition waivers to fee-paying students.
university-of-gothenburg.tests: No SAT/ACT. Swedish-taught programmes require Swedish 3; English-taught programmes require English 6 (typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with writing 20). Programme-specific maths/science prerequisites apply.
strengths: Business (School of Business, Economics and Law)
university-of-gothenburg.gpa_note: Selection mainly by upper-secondary grades (merit rating) when programmes are oversubscribed.
requirements: English 6 (e.g. IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 90) or Swedish 3, depending on the programme
Proof of funds for the Swedish residence permit

university-of-leicester.about:
The University of Leicester, chartered in 1957, has a compact campus close to Leicester city centre. It is known for the discovery of genetic fingerprinting by Sir Alec Jeffreys, the identification of Richard III's remains, a strong space research centre, medicine, law, criminology, and museum studies.

International undergraduates apply through UCAS; each degree page lists its IELTS minimum, and medicine needs the UCAT. Leicester offers competitive merit scholarships for international-fee-paying undergraduates.
university-of-leicester.aid_intl: International Citizens of Change Scholarships (for 2026 entry: 10 awards of up to £10,000 a year for up to three years; 2027 details to be confirmed) and other merit discounts.
university-of-leicester.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English: every degree page specifies a minimum IELTS score; other tests and qualifications are accepted at equivalent levels (tests must be under two years old at course start). Medicine requires the UCAT.
university-of-leicester.gpa_note: Typical offers around AAB–BBB at A-level depending on the course; medicine is higher.
requirements: English test at the degree's IELTS level (or equivalent)
Proof of funds for the UK Student visa (CAS)

university-of-science-and-technology-of-.about:
Founded in 1958 by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, USTC is one of China's most science-focused universities, with campuses in Hefei. It is a world leader in quantum information (including the Micius quantum satellite team), physics, mathematics, chemistry and computer science, and sends a high share of graduates to PhD study.

International undergraduates mostly study in Chinese and need HSK plus a CSCA report; selection considers school records and may include tests or interviews. CSC scholarships are available.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.aid_intl: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-.gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.
requirements: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

university-of-twente.about:
The University of Twente (UT), founded in 1961, is a campus-based technical university in the east of the Netherlands that brands itself 'the people-first university of technology'. It teaches through project-based learning (the Twente Education Model) and offers English-taught bachelor's degrees in fields like electrical, mechanical and civil engineering, computer science, creative technology, industrial design, technical medicine, international business administration and psychology, plus the ATLAS University College.

International applicants apply via Studielink; selective programmes close on 15 January, while most others close on 1 May for non-EEA students. Admission needs a diploma comparable to Dutch VWO, specific maths/physics, and IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90.
university-of-twente.aid_intl: University of Twente Scholarship and Holland Scholarship (partial) for selected non-EEA students.
university-of-twente.tests: No SAT/ACT. English: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 per section (IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and Indicator not accepted), or TOEFL iBT 90 with at least 21 per section (MyBest not accepted). Programme-specific maths/physics requirements apply; some programmes have selection or mandatory matching activities.
university-of-twente.gpa_note: Diploma comparable to Dutch VWO with required maths (and physics for engineering).
requirements: Secondary school diploma comparable to Dutch VWO
English test (IELTS 6.0, min 5.5 per section / TOEFL iBT 90, min 21 per section)
Selection or matching activities for some programmes
Proof of funds for the residence permit

university-of-waikato.about:
The University of Waikato, founded in 1964, has its main campus in Hamilton and another in Tauranga, plus a joint institute in Hangzhou, China. It is known for computer science (including cybersecurity and the WEKA machine-learning tools), its triple-accredited Waikato Management School, environmental and marine sciences, education and Māori studies.

International students apply directly online with their school results and English evidence, and are considered for international excellence scholarships. Intakes are in February/March and July.
university-of-waikato.aid_intl: International merit scholarships (e.g. Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship) offering partial tuition.
university-of-waikato.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency evidence required for non-native speakers (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent at the programme's level).
university-of-waikato.gpa_note: Entry equivalent to NZ University Entrance.
requirements: English test (programme level; IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5 is typical)
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

university-of-wollongong.about:
The University of Wollongong (UOW) is based in the coastal city of Wollongong, about 80 km south of Sydney, with satellite campuses across New South Wales and in Dubai, Hong Kong and Malaysia. It is known for engineering (including materials and steel research), business, IT, nursing and health, and creative arts.

International applicants apply online with secondary results and English evidence at the course's level. UOW accepts major English tests and offers merit scholarships for international students.
university-of-wollongong.aid_intl: International merit scholarships (partial tuition), including UOW Global Excellence awards.
university-of-wollongong.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English: IELTS, TOEFL, Pearson, Cambridge and OET results accepted at each course's required level; previous study in English may also qualify.
university-of-wollongong.gpa_note: Course-specific minimum results for your qualification.
requirements: English test at the course's level
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

victoria-university-of-wellington.about:
Founded in 1897, Victoria University of Wellington has campuses in central Wellington close to Parliament, the courts and government agencies, giving its law, politics, international relations and public policy programmes a practical edge. It is also known for architecture and design, creative writing (IIML), music, earth sciences and computer science.

International students apply directly online and are assessed on their secondary qualification and English (IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5, TOEFL 80 or Duolingo 105). Trimester 1 starts in late February/March, and international scholarships are available.
victoria-university-of-wellington.aid_intl: International merit scholarships (e.g. Tangiwai Scholarship and international excellence awards) and Manaaki New Zealand government scholarships for eligible countries.
victoria-university-of-wellington.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English: IELTS Academic 6.0 with no band below 5.5 (IELTS Online and One Skill Retake accepted); TOEFL iBT 80 (Home Edition accepted); Duolingo 105 with no band below 95; PTE also accepted.
top_programs: Bachelor of Arts (Political Science and International Relations)
victoria-university-of-wellington.gpa_note: Entry by secondary qualification equivalent to NZ University Entrance; limited-entry programmes (e.g. architecture) are selective.
requirements: English test (programme level; IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5 is typical)
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

vrije-universiteit-amsterdam.about:
Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (VU) was founded in 1880 and has a single city campus in Amsterdam's Zuidas district, next to the Amsterdam UMC medical centre. It offers bachelor's programmes across business and economics, law, social sciences, humanities, science, computer science and AI, and health and behavioural sciences, many fully in English.

International students apply via Studielink and the VU dashboard; numerus fixus programmes close on 15 January, other programmes on 1 April for non-EU/EEA students who need a visa. Programme pages list specific maths and English requirements.
vrije-universiteit-amsterdam.aid_intl: Limited merit scholarships for non-EEA bachelor's students (e.g. Holland Scholarship).
vrije-universiteit-amsterdam.tests: No SAT/ACT. Each bachelor's lists its own admission requirements (e.g. mathematics level) and English requirements for English-taught programmes under its 'Admissions' tab.
vrije-universiteit-amsterdam.gpa_note: Diploma must be equivalent to Dutch VWO with required subjects; numerus fixus programmes add selection.
requirements: Secondary school diploma equivalent to Dutch VWO
English proficiency test for English-taught programmes
Studielink registration and VU dashboard application (selection/matching activities for some programmes)
Proof of funds for the residence permit

vrije-universiteit-brussel-vub.about:
VUB was founded in 1834 (as part of the Free University of Brussels, splitting into Dutch- and French-language universities in 1969) and has campuses in Etterbeek, Jette (medicine) and Anderlecht. It values free inquiry, and its location in the EU capital supports strong programmes in social and political sciences, business and economics, law, engineering and medicine.

International students apply online from mid-November; non-EEA applicants needing a visa face an early-spring deadline. English-taught bachelor's require B2 English, Dutch-taught ones B2 Dutch, and fees for non-EEA students are a fixed amount plus a per-credit charge.
vrije-universiteit-brussel-vub.aid_intl: Limited bachelor's-level scholarships for international students.
vrije-universiteit-brussel-vub.tests: No SAT/ACT. You need a secondary diploma that gives university access in your home country (plus any entrance exam certificate required there). Dutch-taught programmes require Dutch at B2 (e.g. CNaVT or ITNA); English-taught bachelor's (e.g. Social Sciences, Business and Economics) require English at B2 via an accepted test.
vrije-universiteit-brussel-vub.gpa_note: Open admission with a qualifying diploma and language proof.
requirements: Secondary diploma granting university access in your home country (plus entrance exam certificate if required there)
Proof of funds for the Belgian student visa

wuhan-university.about:
Wuhan University, founded in 1893, is a comprehensive research university famous for its cherry-blossom campus on the shores of East Lake. It leads globally in surveying, mapping and remote sensing, and is also strong in law, Chinese literature and history, economics and management, and medicine.

International undergraduates apply through the School of International Education with school records, a CSCA report and HSK 4 (180+) for Chinese-taught programmes or TOEFL 80/IELTS 6.0 for English-taught ones. 2026 tuition is RMB 20,000–30,000 a year, and CSC and university scholarships are available.
wuhan-university.aid_intl: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.
wuhan-university.tests: All international undergraduate applicants must take the CSCA (required by Wuhan University from 2026; used for admission and scholarships). Chinese-taught programmes: new HSK 4 with 180+. English-taught programmes: TOEFL 80+, TOEFL Essentials 8+ or IELTS 6.0+ (exemptions for native speakers or English-medium degrees). SAT/ACT not required.
wuhan-university.gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.
requirements: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required
